youtube.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: One Space for 5 Modalities
youtube.description:
EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google’s 740-million-parameter multimodal embedding model. Google says it maps text, code, images, audio and video into a shared embedding space, with an 8K-token context and Apache-2.0 license. It is not a chat model; a search app still needs a retrieval pipeline.
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/embeddinggemma-2/
